name: Mintpal
rootCause: MintPal announce that the attacker stole 8 million VeriCoins ($1.8 million) from the company's hot wallet. The attacker exploited a vulnerability in its system that allowed them to bypass the security controls to withdraw funds.

descriptions.text: MintPal announce that the attacker stole 8 million VeriCoins ($1.8 million) from the company's hot wallet. The attacker exploited a vulnerability in its system that allowed them to bypass the security controls to withdraw funds.

On July 13, 2014, attackers exploited a SQL injection in MintPal's withdrawal system, stealing about 8 million VeriCoin (~$2 million in value) from the exchange's hot wallet. The loss was overwhelmingly restored when the VeriCoin blockchain was hard-forked to orphan the theft transaction. BTC and LTC on MintPal were unaffected due to cold storage. Less than $4,000 in VRC escaped before the rollback and was unrecoverable. A SQL injection vulnerability in MintPal's withdrawal backend allowed an attacker to forge unauthorized withdrawal requests and drain the VeriCoin hot wallet. Poor cold storage practice left most VRC exposed online.
